description: A DigitalOcean project: a folder in the control panel that groups the user's related droplets, Postgres databases and Spaces buckets, for example everything for one app. Every other resource belongs to exactly one of the user's projects, so the user needs one before anything else; resources are put in it by giving its project ID when proposing them (it can still be pending: it's created first). Firewalls belong to a project in this app too, but DigitalOcean can't show them in it. A project can only be destroyed once everything in it has been. It's free and doesn't count towards the user's limit on active requests.

variables.name: name
variables.label: Name
variables.description: Project name: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 54 characters. A short suffix from the request is added to it.

variables.name: description
variables.label: Description
variables.description: What the project is for, shown in the control panel. Optional.

variables.name: purpose
variables.label: Purpose
variables.description: What kind of work the project is for, from DigitalOcean's list.

variables.name: environment
variables.label: Environment
variables.description: Which environment the project's resources are: Development, Staging or Production.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: The project's full name, with the request's suffix.
